subject: CPlaceable / CEntity -- the base of every world object, cold-verified
_note: CEntity is the base class of CBuilding/CDummy/CObject/CPhysical(->CPed,CVehicle). Its fields are inherited by every entity, so proving them raises usable coverage across all of them at once (audit 05_CLASS_STRUCTURE). Offsets proven cold from named engine functions: CEntity::SetModelIndexNoCreate @0x533700 writes `word [this+0x22]` (m_nModelIndex) and does flag bit-ops on `[this+0x1C]` (m_nFlags); CEntity::CreateRwObject @0x533D30 writes the created RwObject to `[this+0x18]` (m_pRwObject) and reads `[this+0x14]` (m_matrix). m_nModelIndex@0x22 also matches the model-info array index (movzx into [eax*4 + 0xA9B0C8]). Sizes from disassembly VALIDATE_SIZE: CPlaceable 0x18, CEntity 0x38, CPhysical 0x138.

fields.name: m_matrix
fields.note: matrix pointer (CPlaceable); read in CreateRwObject to place the RwObject. Classic offset, bracketed by cold m_pRwObject@0x18 and the CPlaceable size 0x18.

fields.name: m_pRwObject
fields.note: RenderWare object; CEntity::CreateRwObject @0x533D30 writes the created object to [this+0x18] (two sites).

fields.name: m_nFlags
fields.note: entity flag bitfield (bUsesCollision, bIsVisible, ...); SetModelIndexNoCreate does read-modify-write bit ops here (xor/and 0x200000, or 0x4000, and 0xF7FFFFFF).

fields.name: m_nRandomSeed
fields.note: random seed; fills 0x20-0x21 between the cold m_nFlags (ends 0x20) and the cold m_nModelIndex (0x22). Classic layout.

fields.name: m_nModelIndex
fields.note: model index (indexes CModelInfo::ms_modelInfoPtrs @0xA9B0C8). CEntity::SetModelIndexNoCreate @0x533700 writes `mov word [this+0x22], ax`. Proven cold.
